relations.evidence: Vandermeersch studied Chinese and Vietnamese at the Institut national des langues et civilisations orientales.

relations.subject: Léon Vandermeersch
relations.evidence: He graduated from the Faculté des lettres de Paris in 1951 with a law degree.

relations.subject: Léon Vandermeersch
relations.evidence: was subsequently curator of the Musée Louis Finot from 1951 to 1958.

relations.subject: Léon Vandermeersch

relations.subject: Léon Vandermeersch
relations.evidence: earned a doctorate from Paris Diderot University in 1975 with a thesis on the institutions of archaic China.

relations.subject: Léon Vandermeersch
relations.evidence: From 1966 to 1973, he taught Chinese at the University of Provence

relations.subject: Léon Vandermeersch
relations.evidence: before directing East Asian studies at Paris Diderot University from 1973 to 1979.

relations.subject: Léon Vandermeersch
relations.evidence: Until his retirement in 1993, he taught history of Confucianism at the École pratique des hautes études.

relations.subject: Léon Vandermeersch
relations.evidence: He headed the Maison franco-japonaise from 1981 to 1984
